purpose: Prevent Heavily Compressed Attention from being treated as a named component before its parent representation, compressor, causal state, and evidence program are explicit.

evidence_basis.supported: HCA uses dense attention over non-overlapping aggressively compressed summaries and complements a separate selective path
evidence_basis.not_transferred: compression rate 128, quality, cache ratio, kernel speed, and million-token capability

evidence_basis.supported: coarse global summaries, precise selected raw blocks, and a local branch solve distinct information needs
evidence_basis.not_transferred: NSA compressor, gate, block size, sparsity, and kernel gains

evidence_basis.supported: compression rate, selection, local window, positional path, precision, and tail state must be reported separately

current_blockers: the recurrent/global sequence backbone is not selected
the exact global-cache representation feeding HCA is not selected
no local HCA compressor or state object exists
compressor parameterization is not isolated from compression rate
causal incomplete-block and prefix-reuse semantics are not implemented
no production-shaped HCA prefill/decode kernel exists
no local quality, compression-sufficiency, or realized-cost evidence exists

causal_semantics_required.blocks: non-overlapping contiguous source blocks of exactly m tokens
causal_semantics_required.emission: a compressed entry becomes visible only after every token in its source block is causally available
causal_semantics_required.incomplete_block: never expose a partial summary to a query that precedes any contributing source token
causal_semantics_required.tail_state: record the exact partial-block accumulator or retained raw tail, position within the block, dtype, and bytes
causal_semantics_required.prefill_decode_parity: chunk boundaries and one-token decode must emit byte-identical block identities and numerically qualified summaries
causal_semantics_required.prefix_reuse: completed summaries may be cached; an incomplete tail must be retained with identity or deterministically recomputed
causal_semantics_required.eviction_resume: summary and tail eviction, serialization, and resume must preserve block numbering and causal visibility
causal_semantics_required.local_coverage: the existing KDA path remains fixed; adding a raw SWA branch is a later separate intervention

fixed: one compression rate and summary budget

reference_arms.role: learn one within-block weight per position, shared across channels
learn within-block weights separately per hidden channel; parameter-match downstream

compressor_isolation_before_rate_selecti.selection_rule: freeze one compressor using independent mechanism-scale discovery and held-out compression-sufficiency plus language/capability floors before comparing rates

conditional_rate_grid.reason: a four-point powers-of-two grid measures a local rate curve around, rather than copying, the published 128-token setting
conditional_rate_grid.control: uncompressed exact global attention using the selected cache representation
conditional_rate_grid.discovery_selection: select the largest rate that passes all hard quality floors and lies on the measured state/prefill Pareto frontier
conditional_rate_grid.confirmation: freeze the selected rate before independent paired finalist cells; do not reuse discovery cells for promotion

accounting_required.complexity_statement: dense attention over L/m summaries reduces the quadratic coefficient but remains O(L^2/m) for length-L prefill

quality_and_mechanism_endpoints: structured retrieval candidate accuracy and specificity
symbolic route, payload, and direct composition
held-out reconstruction or prediction sufficiency of compressed summaries
failure by source-block distance and information load

systems_gate.rule: analytic compression is insufficient; a qualified implementation must improve realized prefill or maximum-resident-batch throughput without failing any quality constraint

decision.next_action: after parent selection, freeze a mechanism-scale compressor-isolation contract and implement only its reference cases
